content:
Michel T said
You can increase the frequency by going to Tools, Composition and Change Auto Save Every [N] minutes

Thanks Michel T - That addresses my original question exactly. Mine was set to 5 and I reduced it to 2.

However, my experience today (twice) is that it was most definitely NOT saved within 5 minutes - if at all. I probably worked on my first lost email for the better part of an hour, explaining some recent revelations about a rather complex system. I'd have been comparatively happy if I only lost 5 minutes of effort!

The second loss seemed to involve a popup about an attachment not being found. I was maybe 30 minutes into it when I saw the pop-up (second time I think) and I somehow popped out of the composition screen. Nothing except the "shell" was saved in Drafts.

Since this install is on Windoze, a lot of my attachments are, to be sure, sitting on Microsoft's Onedrive, which maintains a local clone. I've had an uncomfortable feeling this might cause certain issues...

Thanks! Bob
